stem: Represent graphically the function $g(x) = 3x$. Drag the two points so the line is the graph.
solution: Plot these points on the square net.
Draw the straight line through them.

hints.text: Compare how far up the line goes for each step of 1 to the right, using your table.
Check g(1) in your table: is the point above or below the x-axis?
Find g(0) from the rule to see where the line must cross the y-axis.
Each x has exactly one image, so the graph cannot be vertical. Use the table of pairs.
Find g(0), g(1) and g(-1) from the rule, then plot those pairs.
